notes: A caption whose words happen to describe a time now stays a caption. Asking for a caption that says "from 2 to 6 seconds" burned in nothing at all — Crisp read your own words as an instruction about when to show it, took them away, and left an empty caption while reporting success. "For 5 seconds" did the same. Putting the timing outside the quotes still works exactly as before: caption it "Hello" from 2 to 6 seconds shows Hello between two and six seconds.
